title: Claude Sonnet 5 as New Default Model with Performance Improvements
description: Claude Sonnet 5 became the new default model for Pro, Team Standard, and Enterprise subscription seats, featuring top-tier coding and tool use capabilities. Versions 2.1.26-2.1.30 included 6 new features, 7 improvements, and 12 bug fixes with lower memory usage and faster performance.

community_feedback.quote: Seems like the model is incredibly inefficient at max reasoning, it uses far more tokens. Cost per task is shockingly high.
Sonnet 5.0 basically refuses to do any work. Constantly disagreeing and constantly correcting me even if it has no idea what I'm talking about.
Introducing Claude Sonnet 5, our most agentic Sonnet yet. It makes plans, uses tools like browsers and terminals, and runs autonomously.

title: Version 0.50.0 with Plan Mode and New Commands
description: Gemini CLI released stable version 0.50.0 introducing new Plan Mode feature that forces AI to research before writing code, new commands (/agents refresh, /skills reload), safer auto-updates mechanism, and improved terminal/WSL handling.

community_feedback.quote: Plan Mode is the one Gemini CLI feature I wish I used earlier. It adds time upfront but saves you from cleaning up bad changes later.
Gemini Cli was already losing and it's now being replaced. Lots of people throwing shade at it.
Genuine question - how is Gemini CLI still so far behind? Miles behind Claude and Codex CLIs.

title: Version 0.144.1 with Installer and Code Mode Fixes
description: Codex CLI released version 0.144.1 focusing on standalone installer fixes for GitHub metadata issues and code mode reliability improvements. Also includes enhanced GPT-5.6 Computer Use speed and plugin management enhancements.

community_feedback.quote: Codex CLI gave incorrect code recommendations based on outdated info. Doesn't have access to internet.

title: Version 3.11 with Side Chats and Conversation Search
description: Cursor released version 3.11 introducing Side Chats functionality, Conversation Search capability, new /automate skill, and new triggers for improved workflow automation.

community_feedback.quote: This release makes it easier to stay in flow with side chats that run alongside your main chat.
Cursor 3.11 lets developers run parallel AI chats without stopping their agent.

title: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Models Now Available
description: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 models (Sol, Terra, and Luna) are now available in GitHub Copilot. Additional features include Enterprise-managed OpenTelemetry, review cycles and time tracking, Copilot CLI memory feature, and UI improvements with pinned prompts.

community_feedback.quote: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 family is now rolling out in GitHub Copilot with three variants: Sol (speed), Terra (balanced), and Luna (lowest cost).
GPT-5.6's reasoning tiers appear to populate nearly the whole useful frontier by themselves

title: July 2026 Platform Enhancements and Review Features
description: Devin released multiple updates throughout July including Devin Review for GitLab, MCP marketplace expansion with 48+ new connectors, personal automations, improved Slack integration, and enhanced security features. Classic environment setup deprecated with migration to declarative configuration.

title: No Major Updates in July 2026
description: Based on available changelogs, Windsurf did not have significant updates in July 2026. The latest major version was v1.5.9 from March 2025 featuring Gemini 2.5 Pro beta.

title: Continuous Updates with Latest Model Support
description: Aider continues active development with support for Claude 4.5/4.6, Gemini 2.5/3 preview models, DeepSeek Reasoner, and GPT-5.1/5.2 models. Latest version includes enhanced reasoning effort settings and improved exception handling.

title: No Specific July 2026 Updates Found
description: No specific updates for Continue.dev were found in July 2026. The project appears to have less frequent public release notes or updates may be documented elsewhere.
